desc:
⚾ HIT A BASEBALL! ⚾
Smash the ball as far as you can and ride it down the track! Time your swing for a PERFECT hit, steer left and right, and bounce off cars, mines and cannons for bonus coins and combos!

🚀 NEW: HYPERSPACE WARP
Land a strong hit and blast through a space portal far down the track!

🌍 5 WORLDS
🌱 Grassland Stadium
❄️ Frozen Peaks
🌋 Inferno Arena
💻 Hacker City
😇 Heaven
Reach the finish line to unlock the next world. Beat Heaven and the track never ends!

🎉 EPIC LIVE EVENTS
Giant bosses rise behind the lobby: Frost Yeti, Volcano Eruption, Cyber Hack and Mine Frenzy's War Mech, plus Gold Rush, EXP Storm, Moon Gravity and Rainbow Rush!

⭐ LEVEL UP & REBIRTH
Level up, rebirth up to 150 times and collect 50+ bats and balls. Special balls have their own ability moves, like the T-Rex roar and the Kraken slam!

🎁 Spin the Daily Wheel, play with friends for a coin boost, and join the group for extra coins, EXP and Auto Shoot!

🏆 Climb the global leaderboards!
